summary: Each Dreamer unit is now its own Langfuse trace named for its adaptor (dream:culture, dream:lessons, ...), with its key and outcome on the trace; one tick's units share a session instead of one unnamed dream.pass trace.
details: The trace list now shows which adaptor ran, for which key, and whether it was ok, skipped, unavailable or timed out, without opening the trace.
nora.dreamer.pass_id becomes the Langfuse session.id, so a tick is still readable as a group.
limitations: DreamerRuntime.run still opens its own dream:<adaptor> span, which now nests inside the unit's root under the same name.
Traces before this deploy keep the old dream.pass shape.
